summary: Wilkes County tower listed by tnlandforms at 605 ft with the note 'Ron 1953 topo'. It is the only source found, and nothing is known of the site today.

events.note: The tnlandforms list note for this tower reads 'Ron 1953 topo'. The list does not explain it, and the year is not a build date.

evidence.supports: tnlandforms lists GA420 wilkes in Wilkes County with elevation 605 (no unit stated) and note 'Ron 1953 topo'
the list says names for towers numbered 73 and above are its own creation
evidence.quote: (For towers 73 and above, names are my creation.)

evidence.supports: the list's map shows towers listed in the USGS name database (1-72) and towers discovered on 1:100,000 USGS topo maps and NGS data sheets
evidence.quote: listed by USGS name database (1-72) and as discovered on 1:100,000 USGS topo maps and NGS data sheets

evidence.supports: an older GFC list gives locations for 203 towers (gfc-nnn)
evidence.quote: an older GFC list described the locations of 203 towers (gfc-nnn)

notes_for_editor: Single source: the tnlandforms list. The name 'wilkes' is the list author's own label (towers 73 and above). The elevation 605 is read as feet because no unit is stated (184 m). The note 'Ron 1953 topo' is unexplained. 'Ron' appears on many rows, so it may be a contributor's initials; that is a guess. Other places checked: Forest Lookouts has no Wilkes page under wilkes, tignall or wilkes-county (all 404). Neither the NHLR Georgia list nor the cached FFLOS pages name this site. Do not confuse with GA263 tignall (gfc-011, Wilkes, 642), another tower in the same county. Nothing is known of the site today; the status should stay unknown.
